,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result') AS year_ot ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') AS month_total_ot

-- public_holiday_day ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'public_holiday_day','month_total_ot') AS public_holiday_day ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'public_holiday_day','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS public_holiday_day_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'public_holiday_day','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS public_holiday_day_over_y_raw
-- weekday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'weekday_night','month_total_ot') AS weekday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'weekday_night','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS weekday_night_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'weekday_night','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS weekday_night_over_y_raw
-- weekday_af_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'weekday_af_night','month_total_ot') AS weekday_af_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'weekday_af_night','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS weekday_af_night_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'weekday_af_night','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS weekday_af_night_over_y_raw
-- holiday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'holiday_night','month_total_ot') AS holiday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'holiday_night','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS holiday_night_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'holiday_night','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS holiday_night_over_y_raw
-- public_holiday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'public_holiday_night','month_total_ot') AS public_holiday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'public_holiday_night','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS ph_night_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'public_holiday_night','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS ph_night_over_y_raw
FROM emp_master em WHERE em.subsidiary_code = 'LGDVN' AND em.date_hire_subsidiary <= LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')) AND (em.date_retire >= to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM') OR em.date_retire IS NULL) AND NVL(em.fse_yn, 'N') <> 'Y' AND NVL(em.flsa_yn, 'N') <> 'Y'
AND em.attribute10 = #{shiftCode}
AND em.assignment_category = #{categoryTitle}
AND em.organization_id = #{orgId}
AND em.employee_number = UPPER(#{empNo})
AND UPPER(em.full_name_local) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{empName}) || '%'
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') >= #{monthTotalOtFrom}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') <= #{monthTotalOtTo}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYY'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result_yyyy') >= #{yearTotalOtFrom}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYY'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result_yyyy') <= #{yearTotalOtTo}
) SELECT employee_org ,employee_no ,employee_name ,employee_grade ,actual_shift_code ,employee_category ,to_char(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), 'MM/YYYY') AS attendance_ym_end ,TO_CHAR(date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS date_hire_subsidiary ,year_ot ,month_total_ot
,weekday_day ,CASE WHEN weekday_day_over_m_raw > weekday_day_over_y_raw THEN weekday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS weekday_day_over_m ,CASE WHEN weekday_day_over_m_raw > weekday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE weekday_day_over_y_raw END AS weekday_day_over_y
,holiday_day ,CASE WHEN holiday_day_over_m_raw > holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN holiday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS holiday_day_over_m ,CASE WHEN holiday_day_over_m_raw > holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE holiday_day_over_y_raw END AS holiday_day_over_y
,public_holiday_day ,CASE WHEN public_holiday_day_over_m_raw > public_holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN public_holiday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS public_holiday_day_over_m ,CASE WHEN public_holiday_day_over_m_raw > public_holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE public_holiday_day_over_y_raw END AS public_holiday_day_over_y
,weekday_night ,CASE WHEN weekday_night_over_m_raw > weekday_night_over_y_raw THEN weekday_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS weekday_night_over_m ,CASE WHEN weekday_night_over_m_raw > weekday_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE weekday_night_over_y_raw END AS weekday_night_over_y
,weekday_af_night ,CASE WHEN weekday_af_night_over_m_raw > weekday_af_night_over_y_raw THEN weekday_af_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS weekday_af_night_over_m ,CASE WHEN weekday_af_night_over_m_raw > weekday_af_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE weekday_af_night_over_y_raw END AS weekday_af_night_over_y
,holiday_night ,CASE WHEN holiday_night_over_m_raw > holiday_night_over_y_raw THEN holiday_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS holiday_night_over_m ,CASE WHEN holiday_night_over_m_raw > holiday_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE holiday_night_over_y_raw END AS holiday_night_over_y
,public_holiday_night ,CASE WHEN ph_night_over_m_raw > ph_night_over_y_raw THEN ph_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS public_holiday_night_over_m ,CASE WHEN ph_night_over_m_raw > ph_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE ph_night_over_y_raw END AS public_holiday_night_over_y
FROM raw_data
